fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for change set 01M6YCDW1VM9R8KZPGQR330MAY. No owner was present; the planner read the intent (which quotes the owner's 2026-11-08 words), milestone-25, the ship-change workflow, rhiza ship check's rerun budget, the watchdog's CI rerun and bug filing, and rhiza health. Existing code already reruns a head's failed jobs at most once (ship check and watchdog) and sends a red head with failing tests to one ci-fix fixer that re-runs only those tests. Gaps found: flakes (red that passes on rerun) are not tracked or filed (the watchdog explicitly files no bug for a CI flake), rhiza health shows no CI stability, there is no full local gate before a push, and ci-fix pushes without reproducing locally. Four questions went to the arbiter as one; Decision ci-unstable-gate-rules answered them: serve milestone-25; CI is unstable while the last 20 completed CI runs (a project setting) hold a flake or main's latest run is red; a project-configured local gate command (make check here) runs before every push while unstable, with a health warning when none is set; a flake does not hold the run but is recorded per test and filed once per test as a bug; a head still red after its one rerun is reproduced and fixed or quarantined locally before the next push.
fields.title: Stop using CI as a debugger: autonomous plan interview
